ModMetaData.name: Multiplayer (1.7 port)
ModMetaData.author: RimWorld Multiplayer Team
ModMetaData.description: Unofficial port of Multiplayer to RimWorld 1.7. Requires RimWorld 1.7 and Harmony. Doesn't need Prepatcher. Place this mod right below Core and expansions in the mod list.\n Multiplayer mod for RimWorld, ported to RimWorld 1.7 (.NET 10). This isn't an official release of the RimWorld Multiplayer Team: report problems with this port to its fork, not to the official mod. Fork: https://github.com/ladelisandwich/Rimworld-Multiplayer (branch port-1.7) Official mod (RimWorld 1.6): https://github.com/rwmt/Multiplayer
